signals.visible_as: Partner C's meeting regularity row is the only one below the 80% target, because from week 6 its planned meetings are recorded as not held (poor mobilization, transport difficulty).
In Partner B's facilitator table one CBF's women-who-spoke figure is about double every peer's, and their community reaches Step 7 first.
One Partner A facilitator files identical men/women attendance at nearly every meeting, so their repeat-count rate stands alone while every other CBF sits near zero.
Across the 13 saved weekly reports, Partner B's share of women attending climbs from about a third to level with the other partners.
